title: Ambiguous / Thin Evidence: Won't Turn On
symptom: My computer is completely dead and won't turn on.

expected_output.symptom_summary: User reports device will not power on, but provides insufficient detail to distinguish between AC wall failure, internal PSU fault, or power switch issues.

evidence.text: computer is completely dead and won't turn on

possible_causes.cause: No AC electrical power reaching motherboard power distribution circuitry.
possible_causes.verification: Test electrical outlet with another device and inspect power cable connector.

troubleshooting_steps.action: Ensure the power cable is firmly seated into both the wall outlet and the power supply.

follow_up_questions: When you press the power button, do any lights (LEDs) turn on or blink, even momentarily?
Do you hear any sounds such as fans spinning, beeps, or clicking drives?
Is this a desktop PC or a laptop, and are you using the original power adapter?
